title: Malicious code in @htooayelwinict/travis234 (npm)
description: The npm package @htooayelwinict/travis234 version 3.3.2 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential unauthorized access to all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised. However, removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by this package.
